bends.note: Single ~90 deg press-brake fold along the long edge. Outer skin: 1 = outer face of the plate, 4 = outer face of the ~9.9 mm-deep return flange. The fold arc runs ~155 mm in the part frame (u -85.9..~69.0), from the plate end to the relief notch before the flat end tab; the flange end is cut diagonally at u 63..69. Auto extent t[-85.48, 68.81] = 154.29 mm covers about 99.6% of it. No overrides were needed; margin is the default 3.0.

reconciler.reason: Reconciled: blind labelers A and B both gave 1 bend on outer-skin pair [1,4]. Their only differences were wording: flange depth 7/6/10 mm (the sections give 9.9 mm outer depth and a 6.3 mm flat outer face), a flipped u axis in B's frame, and B's margin_mm 3, which equals the default (B's run matches mine exactly, t[-85.48,68.81]). Own checks: 12 viewpoints, 16 perpendicular sections (u=-86.5..88) and 8 fold close-ups show the same rounded 90 deg L-profile along the flange; the end tab past the notch is flat. Plate and flange skins are flat to about +-0.1 mm (4 mm-bin medians within 0.05 mm) with no kinks, so there are no joggle or small-angle bends. Not bends: holes, the diagonal flange end, the corner cut, the end tab, and inner twins 2/3 plus the mixed pairs. A short strip in the front render is a z-buffer culling artifact, not geometry. It is a real scan: the plate bows slightly, the angle is 90.5 deg and the skin thicknesses are unequal (1.93 vs 1.98 mm). Part 15651004 is CONSUMED (Gold37/other-consumed), not FRESH, so label_lines is the right place. The lines run under the geometry lock exited rc=0 with n_ok=1 and n_failed=0. B1 is ok: 90.50 deg, 154.29 mm, outer skin, confidence certain, fold_support 1.0 with no gaps, coverage 1.0, apex offset 1.597 vs 1.596 expected. Its renders show the line on the fold apex over the full flange, so it ran in one iteration with no fix needed. No write-label was run.
